summary: Optidriver MVP - First iteration end-to-end testing. All 18 backend endpoints and 11 critical frontend flows validated successfully. Backend (15 pytest tests) and Frontend (11 Playwright flows) both at 100%.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py mixes sync hardware/optimizer/restore/drivers calls inside async endpoints (psutil/scans). On Linux they're cheap, but on Windows long-running scans should be wrapped with asyncio.to_thread to avoid blocking the event loop.

AI endpoints catch all exceptions and rethrow as HTTP 500 hiding the original exception type. Consider differentiating timeout/auth/validation errors from upstream LLM. Currently OK but observability could improve.

Mocked APIs on Linux (drivers, GPU, motherboard, services, startup, restore points) are clearly marked 'simulated:true' and labeled SIM in UI - good UX. Confirm real Windows code paths are tested before production.
MOTHERBOARD_IMG is a hardcoded Unsplash URL on Drivers.jsx. Image is relevant (a motherboard) and loads. Acceptable for MVP but consider self-hosting for offline 'local app'.
Real-time metrics polled every 2s via setInterval - no AbortController on fetch; if user navigates away mid-flight, no cancellation. Minor leak risk only.

POST /api/optimize/apply and /api/drivers/update both write to MongoDB AND create an automatic restore point - flow works correctly and is verified persisted (auto_before_optimize and auto_before_driver_update sources confirmed).
seed_data_creation: Test created 1 manual restore point (TEST_E2E_manual_point), 1 manual restore point via header button, 1 simulated optimization run for 'gaming' profile, 1 simulated driver update batch, plus one test point named TEST_manual via pytest. All marked simulated:true in DB collections (restore_points, optimization_logs, driver_updates, ai_sessions, ai_chat_messages).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend exposes all endpoints under /api. AI endpoints (analyze/chat) need >=120s timeout because GPT-5.2 via emergentintegrations can take 30-90s. Pytest file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is the regression suite - run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. Frontend public URL: https://optidriver-preview.preview.emergentagent.com. All UI elements have data-testid attributes (profile-card-{gaming|oficina|optimo}, btn-apply-profile, nav-{dashboard|optimize|drivers|ai|restore}, btn-download-pdf, btn-create-restore-point, ai-profile-{x}, ai-budget-{x}, btn-run-analysis, ai-chat-input, btn-send-message, restore-description-input, btn-create-manual-restore, driver-checkbox-{n}, btn-select-all-outdated, btn-update-drivers, confirm-modal, btn-confirm-update). MongoDB DB_NAME=test_database; collections: restore_points, optimization_logs, profiles, driver_updates, ai_sessions, ai_chat_messages. No auth.
rca of the issue: No issues found. All endpoints respond correctly with expected schemas; auto-restore-point creation chained with optimize/apply and drivers/update is verified; AI integration with GPT-5.2 returns structured recommendation JSON for analyze and free-form text for chat; PDF endpoint returns valid %PDF magic bytes; frontend metrics poll updates every 2s correctly; navigation, modals, toasts and form interactions all functional.
